# Advanced Usage and Case Studies

## Case Study 1: Comparing Animal Coloration Across Lighting Conditions

This case study demonstrates how to analyze how animal coloration appears under different solar conditions.

### Problem
Biologists want to understand how an animal's reflectance properties vary with sun angle, which is important for understanding predator-prey interactions and habitat selection.

### Solution

```r
library(animalreflect)

# Load model and hyperspectral data
model <- load_obj_model("bird_model.obj")
hyper_data <- load_hyperspectral_spe("bird_surface.spe")

# Define time points throughout a day
times <- seq(6, 18, by = 1)  # 6 AM to 6 PM
locations <- list(
  list(date = "2026-06-21", name = "Summer Solstice"),
  list(date = "2026-03-21", name = "Spring Equinox"),
  list(date = "2026-12-21", name = "Winter Solstice")
)

# Storage for results
results_list <- list()

for (loc in locations) {
  results_df <- data.frame(
    time = times,
    elevation = numeric(length(times)),
    illuminated_area = numeric(length(times)),
    mean_reflectance_550 = numeric(length(times)),
    mean_reflectance_850 = numeric(length(times))
  )
  
  for (i, hour in enumerate(times)) {
    time_str <- sprintf("%02d:00:00", hour)
    
    # Calculate solar position
    solar <- calculate_solar_position(
      date = loc$date,
      time = time_str,
      latitude = 40.7128,
      longitude = -74.0060
    )
    
    # Extract projection
    projection <- extract_projection_surface(model, solar)
    
    # Extract reflectance
    reflectance <- extract_reflectance_surface(
      projection, hyper_data, hyper_data$wavelengths
    )
    
    # Get statistics
    mean_refl <- get_mean_reflectance(
      reflectance,
      wavelengths = c(550, 850),
      hyperspectral_wavelengths = hyper_data$wavelengths
    )
    
    # Store results
    results_df$elevation[i] <- solar$elevation
    results_df$illuminated_area[i] <- projection$metadata$n_illuminated_faces
    results_df$mean_reflectance_550[i] <- mean_refl$mean_reflectance[1]
    results_df$mean_reflectance_850[i] <- mean_refl$mean_reflectance[2]
  }
  
  results_list[[loc$name]] <- results_df
}

# Visualize results
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))

for (loc_name in names(results_list)) {
  df <- results_list[[loc_name]]
  
  plot(df$elevation, df$mean_reflectance_550,
       main = paste(loc_name, "- Green (550 nm)"),
       xlab = "Solar Elevation (degrees)", ylab = "Mean Reflectance")
  
  plot(df$elevation, df$mean_reflectance_850,
       main = paste(loc_name, "- NIR (850 nm)"),
       xlab = "Solar Elevation (degrees)", ylab = "Mean Reflectance")
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Key Insights
- Reflectance varies significantly with solar angle
- Summer solstice shows highest illumination
- Different wavelengths respond differently to lighting changes

## Case Study 2: Multi-species Comparative Analysis

Compare reflectance properties across multiple animal species to identify unique spectral signatures.

### Problem
Conservation researchers want to identify distinguishing spectral features of different species to develop automated detection systems.

### Solution

```r
# Define species and their model/hyperspectral data
species_data <- list(
  list(
    name = "Species_A",
    model_file = "models/species_a.obj",
    hyper_file = "images/species_a.spe"
  ),
  list(
    name = "Species_B",
    model_file = "models/species_b.obj",
    hyper_file = "images/species_b.spe"
  ),
  list(
    name = "Species_C",
    model_file = "models/species_c.obj",
    hyper_file = "images/species_c.spe"
  )
)

# Define analysis wavelengths
analysis_wavelengths <- seq(400, 2000, by = 100)

# Storage for spectral signatures
spectral_signatures <- list()

# Process each species
for (species in species_data) {
  cat("Processing", species$name, "...\n")
  
  model <- load_obj_model(species$model_file)
  hyper_data <- load_hyperspectral_spe(species$hyper_file)
  
  # Use consistent solar geometry
  solar <- calculate_solar_position(
    date = "2026-06-21",
    time = "12:00:00",
    latitude = 40.7128,
    longitude = -74.0060
  )
  
  # Extract projection and reflectance
  projection <- extract_projection_surface(model, solar)
  reflectance <- extract_reflectance_surface(
    projection, hyper_data, hyper_data$wavelengths
  )
  
  # Get mean reflectance across all wavelengths
  refl_stats <- get_mean_reflectance(
    reflectance,
    wavelengths = analysis_wavelengths,
    hyperspectral_wavelengths = hyper_data$wavelengths,
    method = "mean"
  )
  
  spectral_signatures[[species$name]] <- refl_stats
}

# Create comparison plot
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
plot(NULL, xlim = c(400, 2000), ylim = c(0, 1),
     xlab = "Wavelength (nm)", ylab = "Mean Reflectance",
     main = "Spectral Signatures of Species")

colors <- rainbow(length(spectral_signatures))
for (i, species_name in enumerate(names(spectral_signatures))) {
  df <- spectral_signatures[[species_name]]
  lines(df$wavelength, df$mean_reflectance, 
        col = colors[i], lwd = 2, label = species_name)
}

legend("topright", names(spectral_signatures), col = colors, lwd = 2)
```

## Case Study 3: Batch Processing with Quality Control

Process a large dataset with comprehensive quality control and error handling.

### Problem
A research team has 500 animal models and needs to process them systematically with detailed quality reporting.

### Solution

```r
# Setup
data_dir <- "research_data"
models_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "obj_models")
images_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "hyperspectral")
output_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "results")
log_file <- file.path(output_dir, "processing_log.txt")

# Get file lists
model_files <- list.files(models_dir, pattern = "\\.obj$", full.names = TRUE)
hyper_files <- list.files(images_dir, pattern = "\\.spe$", full.names = TRUE)

# Match files by basename
matched_files <- data.frame(
  model = character(),
  hyper = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (model_f in model_files) {
  base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(model_f))
  hyper_f <- list.files(images_dir, pattern = base_name, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(hyper_f) > 0) {
    matched_files <- rbind(matched_files, 
                          data.frame(model = model_f, hyper = hyper_f[1]))
  }
}

cat("Found", nrow(matched_files), "matched model-hyperspectral pairs\n")

# Process with batch function
results <- batch_process_animals(
  model_files = matched_files$model,
  hyperspectral_files = matched_files$hyper,
  date = "2026-06-01",
  time = "12:00:00",
  latitude = 40.7128,
  longitude = -74.0060,
  output_dir = output_dir,
  export_projection = TRUE,
  export_reflectance = TRUE,
  wavelengths_extract = c(550, 850, 1650),
  crs = "EPSG:4326",
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Quality control checks
cat("\n=== Quality Control Summary ===\n")
cat("Total processed:", nrow(results), "\n")
cat("Successful:", sum(results$status == "success"), "\n")
cat("Failed:", sum(results$status != "success"), "\n")

if (sum(results$status != "success") > 0) {
  cat("\nFailed files:\n")
  failed <- results[results$status != "success", ]
  for (i in 1:nrow(failed)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s: %s\n", failed$model_file[i], failed$status[i]))
  }
}

# Illumination statistics
illumination <- results$n_illuminated_pixels
cat("\nIllumination Statistics:\n")
cat("  Mean illuminated pixels:", round(mean(illumination), 0), "\n")
cat("  Median illuminated pixels:", round(median(illumination), 0), "\n")
cat("  Range:", min(illumination), "-", max(illumination), "\n")

# Create comprehensive report
create_processing_report(results, output_file = log_file)

# Generate summary statistics
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  total_files = nrow(results),
  successful = sum(results$status == "success"),
  failed = sum(results$status != "success"),
  mean_illumination = mean(illumination),
  median_illumination = median(illumination),
  min_illumination = min(illumination),
  max_illumination = max(illumination),
  mean_processing_time = mean(results$processing_time),
  total_processing_time = sum(results$processing_time)
)

write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "summary.csv"))
```

## Performance Optimization Tips

### 1. Memory-Efficient Processing

```r
# For very large datasets, process in chunks
process_chunk <- function(model_files, chunk_size = 50) {
  for (i in seq(1, length(model_files), by = chunk_size)) {
    end_idx <- min(i + chunk_size - 1, length(model_files))
    chunk <- model_files[i:end_idx]
    
    # Process chunk
    # ... processing code ...
    
    # Force garbage collection
    gc()
  }
}
```

### 2. Parallel Processing

```r
# Use parallel processing for independent models
library(parallel)

process_models_parallel <- function(model_files, n_cores = 4) {
  cluster <- makeCluster(n_cores)
  
  results <- parLapply(cluster, model_files, function(model_f) {
    library(animalreflect)
    
    model <- load_obj_model(model_f)
    solar <- calculate_solar_position(
      date = "2026-06-01", time = "12:00:00",
      latitude = 40.7128, longitude = -74.0060
    )
    
    projection <- extract_projection_surface(model, solar)
    return(projection$metadata$n_illuminated_faces)
  })
  
  stopCluster(cluster)
  return(unlist(results))
}

illuminated_counts <- process_models_parallel(model_files, n_cores = 4)
```

### 3. Caching Results

```r
# Cache solar positions for same date/time
solar_cache <- new.env()

get_solar_cached <- function(date, time, latitude, longitude) {
  key <- paste(date, time, latitude, longitude, sep = "_")
  
  if (!exists(key, envir = solar_cache)) {
    solar_cache[[key]] <- calculate_solar_position(
      date = date, time = time,
      latitude = latitude, longitude = longitude
    )
  }
  
  return(solar_cache[[key]])
}
```

## Data Validation and Error Handling

### Comprehensive Input Validation

```r
validate_workflow_inputs <- function(model_file, hyper_file) {
  errors <- character()
  warnings <- character()
  
  # Check files exist
  if (!file.exists(model_file)) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Model file not found:", model_file))
  }
  if (!file.exists(hyper_file)) {
    errors <- c(errors, paste("Hyperspectral file not found:", hyper_file))
  }
  
  # Check file extensions
  if (!grepl("\\.obj$", model_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    warnings <- c(warnings, "Model file does not have .obj extension")
  }
  if (!grepl("\\.spe$", hyper_file, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    warnings <- c(warnings, "Hyperspectral file does not have .spe extension")
  }
  
  # Check file sizes
  if (file.size(model_file) > 500 * 1024 * 1024) {  # 500 MB
    warnings <- c(warnings, "Model file is very large (>500MB)")
  }
  
  return(list(errors = errors, warnings = warnings))
}

# Usage
validation <- validate_workflow_inputs("model.obj", "image.spe")
if (length(validation$errors) > 0) {
  stop(paste(validation$errors, collapse = "\n"))
}
if (length(validation$warnings) > 0) {
  warning(paste(validation$warnings, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

## Integration with Other R Packages

### Integration with `terra` for Spatial Analysis

```r
library(animalreflect)
library(terra)

# Export projection and load with terra
export_projection_tif(projection, "output.tif", crs = "EPSG:4326")
raster_data <- rast("output.tif")

# Perform spatial analysis
raster_aggregated <- aggregate(raster_data, fact = 5)
plot(raster_aggregated)
```

### Integration with `ggplot2` for Visualization

```r
library(animalreflect)
library(ggplot2)

# Convert results to data frame for ggplot
reflectance_df <- data.frame(
  wavelength = spectral_signatures$Species_A$wavelength,
  reflectance = spectral_signatures$Species_A$mean_reflectance,
  species = "Species A"
)

ggplot(reflectance_df, aes(x = wavelength, y = reflectance)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Spectral Signature", x = "Wavelength (nm)", y = "Reflectance")
```

## Troubleshooting Advanced Issues

### Memory Issues with Large Datasets

```r
# Solution 1: Process in chunks
chunk_process <- function(files, chunk_size = 10) {
  for (i in seq(1, length(files), by = chunk_size)) {
    chunk <- files[i:min(i + chunk_size - 1, length(files))]
    process_chunk(chunk)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)  # Force garbage collection
  }
}

# Solution 2: Use temporary files
use_temp_processing <- function(model, hyper_data) {
  temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
  saveRDS(model, temp_file)
  
  model_loaded <- readRDS(temp_file)
  # Process model_loaded
  
  unlink(temp_file)  # Clean up
}
```

### Handling Incomplete SPE Data

```r
# Check and validate hyperspectral data
validate_hyperspectral <- function(hyper_data) {
  issues <- character()
  
  if (is.null(hyper_data$data) || all(is.na(hyper_data$data))) {
    issues <- c(issues, "Hyperspectral data is empty")
  }
  
  if (is.null(hyper_data$wavelengths)) {
    issues <- c(issues, "Wavelength information missing")
  }
  
  if (any(is.infinite(hyper_data$data))) {
    issues <- c(issues, "Data contains infinite values")
  }
  
  return(issues)
}
```
